notes.title: My new game ‘The Matriarch’ is releasing in 2 weeks!
notes.notes:
I’m thrilled to announce that The Matriarch will be released on September 26th

Midway between ‘The Escapists’ and ‘Among Us’, ‘The Matriarch’ is an online party game where players emulate BOTs' behavior to hide from an evil Matriarch (also controlled by a player) who has to identify and sacrifice the player characters. On top of hiding from the Matriarch, players have to cooperate to find the exit and escape the satanic convent.  

Check it out! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1773180/The_Matriarch/

notes.title: Psychocat the Door is out NOW!
notes.notes:
Psychocat The Door is available NOW! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1384820/Psychocat_The_Door/


This time, Zag the cat is trapped in a nightmare and you'll have to catch the Door to get him out of it! 

Psychocat The Door builds up on the inverted control mechanic & visuals of  Psychocat the answer while expanding all the other aspects!  
Explore 20+ trippy levels and be ready to turn your brain upside down to dodge the numerous obstacles that stand between you and the Door! 


How many tries will it take you to catch the Door ?

notes.title: 01/21 Issues solved with 32 bit OS / Achievement pop-ups / Colors change
notes.notes:
Hello,

I made a quick update that should have solved the following issues:

- Unable to launch the game on 32bit OS
- Achievement pop-ups are not displayed properly
- Sometimes the color of the cat is not the same that the area he goes through

Since I dont have the proper PC to make some test, I'm not 100% sure those issues are solved, but it should be !

If you still see some issues, please don't hesitate to post a message on the forum !

Thank you for your comprehension, and good luck in your quest to find Zag's answer !

notes.title: Achievement & Debug
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I've put an update for the Achievements, it seems to work for some user and not for the other, and the pop-up windows that announce the achievement is not displayed properly (only when you close the game), I'll try to fix those issues as soon as possible, sorry for the inconvenience, and thank you for your patience.

Also, I solved a bug where you were able to pass through the blue-circle obstacle.

Thank you for your support.
